pr.title: fix(context): single body overrides other returns

summary: This PR is a type-only fix: `Context#body()`'s return type is changed from plain `Response` to `Response & TypedResponse<..., U, 'body'>`, mirroring `.text()/.json()`. The runtime implementation of `#newResponse`/`body` is unchanged aside from a cast, so there is no behavioral change to actual HTTP responses. The purpose is to fix RPC/hc client type inference so a `c.body()` branch no longer widens/overrides other branches' typed statuses (issue #3798), and a types.test.ts case verifies this via `expectTypeOf`.
